namespace.description: The namespace on the workload cluster to deploy the metrics agent and the copied prometheus-write secret into

targetCluster.description: The workload cluster the metrics agent gets deployed into remotely

kubeconfigSecretName.description: Name of the Secret (in this release's own namespace, on the management cluster) holding the workload cluster's kubeconfig, e.g. the CAPI-provided '<cluster>-kubeconfig' secret. Only needed if this release isn't installed as '<cluster-name>-mm' -- otherwise it's derived automatically and this can be left empty

prometheus.description: Central Prometheus this cluster's managed-service metrics get remote-written to

existingSecret.description: A Secret with 'username'/'password' keys, already present in this release's own namespace on the management cluster. It gets copied into the workload cluster (as 'prometheus-write') for the metrics agent to use
